mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY > 2% does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in Real Final Sales of Goods signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or RSAFS decline does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdowns.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals labor market distress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE spike does not correlate with immediate market downturns.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% in one month signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO increase does not correlate with subsequent market rallies.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) and a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases simultaneously
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint labor market improvement does not correlate with subsequent market rallies.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) signals strengthening demand in the housing sector, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or HOUST increase does not correlate with subsequent market rallies.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) coupled with an increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a supply-side shock and weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decreases and UNRATE increases simultaneously
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint supply and labor market deterioration does not correlate with subsequent market downturns.
